points.requirement: Separate research intended use, laboratory test origin, laboratory certification and product authorization.

evidence.explanation: Separately defines intended research purpose, laboratory test origin, laboratory-quality oversight and product/intended-use authorization; none forms a universal usefulness ladder.

remaining: Add a dedicated explanation of CLIA versus product authorization; qualify RUO and LDT categories.

evidence.explanation: RUO explanation covers intended research use but generalizes it to every research model/dataset.

remaining: Avoid blanket claims that every LDT clinical claim lacks FDA review; use current official text.

evidence.explanation: Retains the 2025 vacatur/restoration history.

points.requirement: Distinguish establishment registration and device listing from product approval, clearance or authorization.

evidence.explanation: The new note expressly distinguishes FDA establishment registration or device listing from approval, clearance or authorization.

remaining: New explanatory note must pass the final rendering/source check.
